Product description update (2022)
Disability Insurance with Step Rated Premiums
An exclusive pricing structure just for physicians - start with a lower premium that gradually increases over time.
Additionally, enhance your coverage and choose the option for our strongest definition of disability, to allow you to collect benefits even if you return to work in another occupation. Additional cost applies.
Disability disclosure on payment page :
Your rate for step-rated plans will increase due to age at age 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60 and 65. Rates could also increase annually based on the claims experience for the entire group. AMA-sponsored disability base rates have not increased since 1999.
The AMA-sponsored Disability Income Plans are underwritten by New York Life Insurance Company, 51 Madison Ave., New York, NY 10010, under Group Policy No. G-30639-0 and Group Policy No. G-30641-0 on Policy Forms GMR-FACE/G-30639-0 and GMR-FACE/G-30641-0. Plans may not be available in all states and product features may vary by state.
Quotes are for illustrative purposes only. Rates and premium credits are reviewed and may change annually. The quote with step rates includes a premium credit and varies by AMA membership status. The premium credit is locked in when coverage is issued and is guaranteed for at least the first year of coverage.
Rates are based on your age, gender, state of residence, and on the effective date of coverage. Step rated plans are based on your attained age on each renewal date, while level rated plans are based on your issue age. Depending on plan experience, premiums may change on the plan anniversary date (July 1) or your annual renewal date (whichever is later).
Under these plans, insureds cannot work in any occupation during the elimination period.
2022 AMA Insurance Agency, Inc., a subsidiary of the American Medical Association.
